title: Federal court postpones the duration of status final rule
agency: U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts
content: On 14 September 2026 the U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts postponed, nationwide and under section 705 of the Administrative Procedure Act, the effective date of the DHS final rule that replaces duration of status admission for F-1 and J-1 students with a fixed period. The rule had been due to take effect on 15 September 2026. The case is Presidents' Alliance on Higher Education and Immigration v. DHS, No. 1:26-cv-13799. DHS has appealed. While the order stands, the rule is not in effect.
